newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were mostly steady Thursday, capping a shortened holiday week of lackluster activity, dealers said.
"I would say we are almost in a holding mode," a Buffalo dealer said, referring to the quiet activity.
In the southeast, Minneapolis and West Texas areas, dealers reported very little business.
"We had a few trucks sold," one Minneapolis dealer said. "But this is a pretty quiet day."
Dealers also said flour mills reduced their production. The market will be closed Friday in observance of U.S. Independence Day.
